title: ‘Foreign funding’ farce: The hypocrisy of the Modi government’s allegations against protesters

ai.summary: The Modi government claims foreign funding for anti-SIR protests that have disenfranchised 130 million people, but the article shows the government itself has used dark money and loopholes to fund political parties without transparency.

facts.quote: Besieged by youth protests against SIR that has disenfranchised 130 million people so far

ai.background_note: The Modi government alleges foreign funding for anti-SIR protests, but the article reveals the government's own use of dark money and FCRA loopholes to fund political parties without transparency.
